page.title: About — Pranav PT
page.description: Meet Pranav PT — the person on a mission to make technology understandable for every human, from age 11 to 80.

sections.headline: Hi, I'm Pranav.
sections.subheadline: I believe technology is not complicated. It's just been explained badly. I'm here to change that.

sections.title: Why I started this
sections.body: Most people interact with technology every day but have no idea how any of it works. They use apps, AI tools, and automation — but feel dependent, confused, and sometimes even intimidated. I started Pranav PT because I realized the gap isn't intelligence. It's explanation. When you explain technology through real-world analogies — the way you'd explain a car engine to someone who drives one — everything becomes clear.

visual.description: A person looking at a transparent, open technology diagram — curious, not afraid

sections.quote: Just like car enthusiasts understand engines, gears, and pistons — technology learners should understand code, frontend, servers, automation, and AI. Not to memorize. To think.

features.title: Simplify, not dumb down
features.description: Technology is explained simply enough for an 11-year-old without being condescending to a 40-year-old professional.

features.title: Make people fall in love with learning
features.description: The goal is not just to teach — it's to make you genuinely curious and excited about how things work.

features.title: From user to builder
features.description: Every person who goes through this journey moves from passively using technology to actively customizing and building with it.
